About RevStar At RevStar, we build cutting-edge cloud, data, and Generative AI solutions that transform how enterprise organizations operate. As an Advanced AWS Consulting Partner, we don’t just deliver code—we solve complex business problems, modernize legacy infrastructure, and deploy production-grade cloud native and AI applications that drive real business value.


Role Overview We are seeking a Senior AWS Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to join our AWS Practice. In this highly visible role, you will operate embedded directly at the intersection of enterprise cloud architecture, hands-on engineering, and client-facing delivery.


As an FDE, you are both a master cloud builder and a trusted technical advisor. You will own the full delivery lifecycle for high-impact enterprise accounts—architecting resilient cloud-native environments, modernizing legacy infrastructure, and deploying state-of-the-art AWS Generative AI (Amazon Bedrock, Q, SageMaker) architectures. Simultaneously, you will drive AWS adoption and consumption growth by identifying new workloads, building POCs, and driving strategic technical alignment with client executive leadership.


Key Responsibilities* 
Hands-On Cloud Architecture & Implementation:
 Design, build, and deploy secure, scalable, and resilient cloud architectures on AWS using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, AWS CDK, CloudFormation) and modern microservices/serverless patterns (Lambda, ECS/EKS, API Gateway, DynamoDB). * 
Enterprise Customer Delivery:
 Serve as the primary technical leader on strategic enterprise client engagements. Partner with CIOs, CTOs, VPs of Infrastructure/Engineering, and client development teams to translate complex business goals into high-performing AWS solutions. * 
Cloud Migration & Application Modernization:
 Lead large-scale migrations from on-premises data centers or legacy platforms to AWS (using AWS Application Migration Service, Database Migration Service, etc.) and re-architect legacy monolithic applications into modern serverless or containerized architectures. * 
AWS Generative AI & Machine Learning:
 Architect and deploy enterprise GenAI and ML workloads leveraging Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, Vector Databases (OpenSearch, Pinecone, pgvector), and custom RAG implementations. * 
Drive Platform Adoption & Growth:
 Partner with RevStar account leadership to identify new, high-value cloud workloads within client accounts, driving AWS consumption expansion and clear ROI for client executive stakeholders. * 
Technical Mentorship & Practice Building:
 Coach and mentor Cloud Engineers and Solutions Architects. Drive internal RevStar accelerators, reusable Terraform modules, AWS Well-Architected Review frameworks, and cloud delivery best practices.


Requirements


Qualifications & RequirementsTechnical Expertise:* 6+ years of hands-on experience in Cloud Architecture, DevOps/SRE, or Software Engineering with a focus on AWS. * 3+ years in a client-facing consulting, Solutions Architecture, or Forward Deployed Engineering role. * Deep AWS Core Expertise: Mastery across core AWS services (IAM, VPC, EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, S3, RDS, DynamoDB, CloudFront, Route 53). * Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & CI/CD: Expert-level proficiency in Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation, along with automated CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, AWS CodePipeline). * AWS GenAI & Data Services: Practical experience with Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, Glue, Redshift, or OpenSearch for building data platforms and AI solutions. * AWS Certifications: AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional and/or AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional required. Specialty certifications (Security, Machine Learning, Data Analytics) are a plus.


Client & Business Acumen:* Enterprise Track Record: Proven experience leading technical delivery for Fortune 500 or mid-market enterprise clients (Healthcare, Financial Services, Retail, or SaaS). * Consulting & Communication Skills: Outstanding verbal and written communication; adept at whiteboarding complex architectures, building working POCs/demos, and presenting to C-level executives. * Growth Mindset: Ability to spot technical expansion opportunities, conduct AWS Well-Architected Reviews, and advocate for cloud modernization to expand account footprint.


Benefits


Paid Time Off
 – Take the time you need to recharge and stay productive.
Remote-First Working Environment
 – Collaborate from anywhere while staying connected with our global team.
Comprehensive Health Coverage
 – Medical, Dental, Vision
401(k) Retirement Plan
 – Plan for your future with access to a company-sponsored 401(k) program.
Annual Learning & Development Stipend
 – Invest in your skills with conferences, certifications, or courses.
Peer Mentorship & Coaching
 – Learn from experienced engineers, product managers, and architects to accelerate your growth.
Professional Growth Opportunities
 – Exposure to cutting-edge AWS GenAI, data, and cloud technologies across diverse industries.
Company Outings & Volunteer Opportunities
 – Build relationships and give back to the community.
Collaborative, Innovative Culture
 – Work alongside top talent in a fast-paced, supportive environment that values curiosity and initiative.

About goTenna


goTenna is the world's leading mobile mesh networking company, providing off-grid connectivity solutions for smartphones and other devices, as well as augmenting traditional communications networks. This technology enables mobile, long-range connectivity without cell, Wi-Fi, or satellite connectivity. goTenna's products are currently in use by law enforcement, military, and public safety agencies worldwide. goTenna is a wholly owned subsidiary of Forterra, a leading provider of ground autonomy solutions for the US Department of Defense and other organizations.


About the role:


The Forward Deployed Engineer is an integral part of the goTenna Customer Experience Team that manages the technical aspects of our company’s relationship with customers that use our Pro line of products. Pro customers include, but are not limited to, local and national Public Safety organizations, U.S. and international military, and other federal government agencies. You will provide accurate technical service and support before and after the point of sale to include both onsite and virtual training, and equipment installation, ensuring customer satisfaction throughout the customer journey.


As our Forward Deployed Engineer, in addition to being a critical member of our Customer Experience Team, you will also work closely with all of our Marketing, Sales, Product, Engineering, and Solutions Architect teams. On the product and engineering side, you will be instrumental in advocating for our customers by proactively identifying issues and enabling an effective voice of the customer (VOC) program to propose product enhancements, new functionality and new products. On the business development side, you will help win new business by assisting in RFP’s, demos, trade shows and Q&A sessions. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you should expect your time to be spent between these activities: Technical Support, conducting Onsite/Virtual Training, equipment installations, working with Product and Engineering and supporting Business Development with demo’s, trade shows, and Q&A.


Up to 50% travel may be required.


Primary Responsibilities:


Engage with Public Safety, Military, and other Pro customers
Monitor and answer support requests relating to all of our Pro line of products
Document current use cases, issues, and opportunities
Provide regular reports to leadership on product and customer performance in order to help develop future strategies and roadmap
Work cross-functionally with other departments such as Product Management and Engineering in order to successfully troubleshoot technical issues
Ensure compliance with all regulatory requirements
Conduct both Virtual and Onsite training and equipment installations with Customers
Support technical presales activities, such as on-site or virtual customer demos
Support business development activities such as RFPs, demo, trade shows, etc.
Stay up to speed on the latest technological advancements in our industry as well as the latest employment criteria of our customers


Required Experience:


6+ years of professional experience, preferably deploying or utilizing technology products in a Public Safety or Military organization. Some of your experience should have been related to tactical communications
Solid technical background with hands on experience in digital technologies
An ability to grasp customers’ needs and suggest timely solutions
Exceptional organizational, presentation, and verbal + written communication skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Physical ability to carry 30 pounds of equipment and work in austere conditions
Experience with CRM tools and ticketing systems such as Salesforce or Jira
A highly motivated self-starter with outstanding planning and organizational skills with the ability to work independently and communicate effectively
A tech-savvy professional, able to explain technical details and requirements to both a non-technical audience and an extremely technical audience via onsite and virtual engagements.
A problem-solver with a strong work ethic that can execute and provide quick and effective resolutions to our customers questions
Someone who is customer/service oriented and enjoys building strong customer relationships
A strategic thinker and planner that is adept at thinking outside the box and has a bias for action
Able to lift 30 lbs.
An evangelist for our product


Preferred Experience:


A passion for dealing in tactical communications and technology
Operational experience such as prior active-duty military, law enforcement, or Public Safety experience (either as a full time or volunteer), including but not limited to: emergency management, search & rescue, wildland firefighting, disaster response, etc.
Passion for goTenna and our mission to build a distributed communication network from the ground-up!

Our mission


Great science regularly stalls in the clinic, not because the science is wrong, but because the company behind it lacks the capital, infrastructure, or focus to take it all the way through. Today’s clinical-stage biopharma model is broken, and as a result promising treatments never reach patients.


Our mission is to fix this: we’re building the next generation of biopharma by in-licensing clinical-stage therapeutic assets and developing them through Lindus Health’s integrated, technology-first clinical trial infrastructure. We’re a new initiative, but we’re building on a proven foundation - the same infrastructure that has delivered 82% of Lindus Health’s sponsor trials on or ahead of timeline, across 40+ completed trials across the US and Europe.


We’re in-licensing 5-7 clinical-stage, typically Phase-2-ready assets, funded directly from Lindus Health’s balance sheet. We’re targeting deal close on our first assets through 2026, with first trials launching in H1 2027.


About the role


The Forward Deployed Engineer is an embedded member of the trial team, delivering the technical solutions assigned studies need. You build the study across the Citrus ecosystem, set up and manage its integrations and data pipelines, and help produce the databases, data, and artifacts a trial depends on, accurate and compliant.


This is a technical role. You write code, build the automation and tooling that keep quality high, and take part in the fire team, with platform work done under software engineering oversight. Trial delivery is the priority and the technical work serves it.


About you


We'd like to hear from you if…


You have 3-6 years of experience in software, data, or systems work, through a degree in a technical field or hands-on work, and can deliver independently once pointed at a problem; experience in clinical trials or life sciences is a plus
You are a capable engineer; you are proficient in coding and AI tools. Experience with Django admin and/or relational databases is valued
You are precise and thorough, with the attention to detail to spot gaps and ambiguities before they become problems
You are driven to understand and solve problems, and comfortable collaborating across technical and non-technical teams
You can prioritize effectively and keep track of several things at once without letting them slip
You are interested in working in a regulated environment, and can build systems and produce documentation that holds up under audit or inspection
You thrive in a startup environment that challenges the norms of typical biotechs, with high agency and a bias for action
You are passionate about our mission: changing how the healthcare industry operates and how new health treatments are developed


What you'll focus on


Build assigned studies across the Citrus ecosystem from approved designs, covering data collection forms, participant schedules, logic and edit-check rules, and user access
Set up and manage the integrations and data pipelines a study depends on
Run quality checks, build validation and coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to confirm the build matches the specification, and coordinate go-live
Make approved changes to live studies, keeping them accurate and compliant as trials evolve
Take part in the Citrus trial technical support team, owning tickets for data corrections and the data warehouse and helping to debug Citrus under software engineering oversight
Build automated and agentic workflows that produce high-quality, compliant data
Make contributions to the core Citrus codebase where needed, with software engineering oversight
Provide technical review and input into Data Architects' designs, then build from them and work with the full trial team to deliver studies, flagging gaps or ambiguities early
Conduct all activities in line with relevant regulations and Lindus SOPs, and keep documentation to a standard that holds up under audit or inspection
